projectSummary: Age and sex change the mechanical behaviour of the pectoralis major regions. This is why a statement about regional behaviour derived from a single-sex or single-age-band sample cannot be generalised without a qualifier.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

study.intervention: Shear-wave elastography of pectoralis major fibre regions during volitional contraction, across age and sex.
study.population: Ultrasound shear wave elastography acquired shear wave velocity from the clavicular and sternocostal fibre regions of 48 healthy participants: 24 younger (12 male, 12 female, mean age 25 (SD 4.1) years) and 24 older adults (12 male, 12 female).

title: Age and sex influence the activation-dependent stiffness of the pectoralis major.
